title: Applying Large Language Models to Sponsored Search Advertising
authors: Martin Reisenbichler; Thomas Reutterer; David A. Schweidel
eligible_reason: Field experiments in Google Ads comparing LLM-generated with human-written search ads (IT/SaaS and education campaigns). Main tables use chi-square, Kruskal-Wallis, Wilcoxon and proportion tests across experimental groups. No regressions, no DiD.
design_notes: main paper tables and figures/Table 3-6 IT.R, Figure 5-6 IT.R: aggregate by experimental group, chisq.test, kruskal.test, prop.test.
data_files_note: Campaign-level ad performance data shipped as RData.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
